'''Jeff Weitkamp''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Gold 40 from Hazelwood, Mo. The published fan table marks the slot Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run. He was the tournament director of the [[Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck]] tournament at [[DecipherCon 2000]].<ref name="fkl2">[http://www.decipher.com/deciphercon/2000/reports/fkl2.html Mighty Jabba Sails Across the Atlantic], Francis K. Lalumiere, Decipher (5 October 2000). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010107221700/http://www.decipher.com/deciphercon/2000/reports/fkl2.html Wayback Machine]</ref>

== Squadron listing ==

{| class="wikitable"

| Gold 40 || Hazelwood, Mo || Retired

Decipher recruited volunteer Squadron Members in the 1990s to promote SWCCG locally (tournaments, demos, player support). "FL" is printed on some slots in the surviving tables; the tables do not spell out the abbreviation.
